summary: Fixed normalized_key_skeleton's NFKC->recompose bug (switched to NFKD) so U+00FC and other precomposed-diacritic homoglyphs fold to their ASCII base letter instead of being silently dropped. Added V1..V5 regression tests. cargo test green in crate and workspace. Re-ran V-B01's own 5 probes (verbatim bodies) plus the original A1..A8: 13/13 detected on the repaired build. Positive control: same harness against a byte-verified copy of the pre-fix crate reproduces V-B01's exact finding (V1, V2 slip).
